M squared.subject: Indian Languages
M squared.question: The _____ was Measure of laser beam quality.
M squared.fact: In laser science, the parameter M2, also called the beam propagation ratio or beam quality factor, is a measure of laser beam quality. It represents the degree of variation of a beam from an ideal Gaussian beam.

M squared.subject: Indian Languages
M squared.question: It represents the degree of variation of a beam from an ideal _____ beam
M squared.fact: It represents the degree of variation of a beam from an ideal Gaussian beam. It is calculated from the ratio of the beam parameter product (BPP) of the beam to that of a Gaussian beam with the same wavelength.

M squared.question: Multi-mode beam propagation can be modeled by considering an imaginary "embedded" _____, whose beam waist is M times smaller than that of the multimode beam
M squared.fact: Multi-mode beam propagation can be modeled by considering an imaginary "embedded" Gaussian, whose beam waist is M times smaller than that of the multimode beam. The diameter of the multimode beam is then M times that of the embedded Gaussian beam everywhere, and the divergence is M times greater, but the wavefront curvature is the same.
